arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_transactions, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate FROM transactions t JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) WHERE ml.state = 'Italy'
arguments.explanation: Returns the fraud rate for labelled transactions at merchant locations in Italy, along with the number of labelled transactions and how many of them were fraud.
assumptions: Merchant locations in Italy are those where merchant_locations.state = 'Italy', since state holds the country name for locations outside the US.
The fraud rate counts labelled transactions only. Transactions without a label are left out.
